The '''automated vulture droid deployment station''', also simply called the '''Vulture droid base''', was used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] to deploy [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Vulture_droid_deployment_pod2.png|thumb|left|200px|An inactive droid base in orbit over Felucia]]

Vulture droid bases were equipped with six of the Separatist fighters for which it was named, which were contained in the sealed pod until an intruder was detected. When a threat approached, the pods would open and release the waiting activated Vulture droids from its docking rack to commence an attack on the approaching [[Starship/Legends|vessel]].<ref name="BH" /> They were often placed around neutral [[Planet/Legends|planets]] to intercept and destroy [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Scout ship/Legends|scout ships]].<ref name="Dataclip">{{CN|url=tv_shows/starwars/?episodeID=8a250ab0274ee03e0127bfa1e53c06a4|text=Dataclip: Bounty Hunters|na=video file}}</ref>

==History==
During the Clone Wars, after destroying the [[Haven-class medical station/Legends|''Haven''-class medical station]] [[Felucia medical station/Legends|stationed over Felucia]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] left at least one deployment pod in orbit around [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]]. When [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] arrived in-system to investigate the status of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] medical [[Space station/Legends|station]], the pod was activated and proceeded to dispatch its payload of six Vulture droids. The droids succeeded in damaging the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] unarmed [[T-6 shuttle/Legends|T-6 shuttle]] causing it to crash on the planet's surface.<ref name="BH" />

==Behind the scenes==
The automated vulture droid deployment station was designed by [[Kilian Plunkett]] for season 1 of [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'']] animated series. It was then known as the ''Vulture droid Stall'' but did not make into the series until the second season episode [[Bounty Hunters (episode)|Bounty Hunters]].<ref name="ArtofCW">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''</ref>
